kind: prospective fixed route-free fresh task intake prerequisite

panel.priority_rule: Four entries, entry i = 10 iff mask & (1 << i), else 0; native order unchanged.
panel.branch_rule: Each mask independently extends the same exact accepted completed source; no simultaneous task queue or skipped older need.
panel.payload_rule: Copy exact original task proposition, context, cue, target, scope, amount, collective/commit/externalize and evidence; replace only weights or priorities with fixed mask values. New ft.fresh.task identity; no role/route/recipe/success fields.
panel.fresh_skill_work: Not implemented or claimed in this subbatch; mandatory continuation.

runtime.constructor: Validate exact original social feedback/source/native pairing, complete terminal source, unlocked actor, no current non-retracted/disputed owned need lacking an exact fulfilled original controller outcome. Reject before mutation otherwise.
runtime.operations: Declare new ordinary draft; fresh disclose/read exact payload (2 energy/time), then bind exact draft using original particulars plus new paid read (3 energy/time). No comparison, movement or consumer work.
runtime.staging: Before/read partial/read complete/bind partial have no intake receipt. Complete bind yields one exact paid owned task receipt. One quantum per step in gate. Exact read-partial and bind-partial restart; terminal idempotence.
runtime.immutability: Preserve original native journal and command/access prefixes; old source, social reserve/history and controller bytes unchanged, separately bind native extension. No old wrapper regeneration.
runtime.outputs: Explicit new intake-v1 schema, receipt only for new task read+bind. comparison_paid=false,execution_authorized=false,td5_admitted=false,history_choice=false. No request/route admission or current role domain coverage claim.

audit: Separate auditor does not import runtime executor. Full native audit, exact original source audit, reconstruct fixed draft and task payload, native operations and command/access suffixes, actual wallet debit, exact new binding/evidence receipt, immutable old records and ledgers. Reject forged receipt/payload/prefix. Any unrelated extension rejected. Audit every decoded saved record.
claim_boundary: Actual paid fixed fresh task intake only, not autonomous goal invention, new skills, TD5 admission, genuine tie, history-caused choice, movement/downstream use, parent FT7 or FT8/FT9 acceptance. Changed future inputs need new paid comparison and separate composition proof. All FT8 denominators/matched costs and C/D theory holds unchanged.
failure_policy: Preserve all failed attempts, preregister concrete corrections before code, freeze before each bounded gate; never rerun accepted paid gates.
